name: workbench
description: Four independent explicit skills for change analysis, per-task model planning, isolated execution, and local project-knowledge curation.

interface.shortDescription: Independent tools for software change analysis and execution.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides four independently useful, explicitly invoked skills. Investigate changes with selective research delegation, plan task-specific Astra/Sol/Luna models and reasoning efforts, execute isolated task DAGs with verification and user steering, or curate local .codocs knowledge with sequential writes.
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:shape to investigate this software change.
Use $workbench:prepare to plan tasks, worker profiles, isolation, and verification.
Use $workbench:execute-task to execute this plan using its task profiles.
Use $workbench:memory-update to curate these local project-knowledge topics.
